observation.command:
cd /tmp
# List available linux-amd64 assets across recent releases
for tag in "RELEASE.2025-06-13T01-01-09Z" "RELEASE.2025-01-17T00-16-23Z" "RELEASE.2024-12-13T22-19-13Z"; do
  url="https://github.com/minio/minio/releases/download/${tag}/minio.linux-amd64.${tag}"
  code=$(timeout 20 curl -sSL -o "minio_$tag" -w "%{http_code}" "$url")
  sz=$(stat -c%s "minio_$tag" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "$tag -> HTTP $code size=$sz"
  if [ "$code" = "200" ] && [ "$sz" -gt 1000000 ]; then
    chmod +x "minio_$tag"
    ver=$(timeout 10 ./minio_$tag --version 2>&1 | head -1)
    echo "   version: $ver"
  fi
done
